Who is Ryan Laney?

J. Hollis, to make their debut at the Motor Speedway of the South race, following Speedy Comet being fired.

Sometime before the Florida 500, when being told in an interview that Lightning McQueen has not shown up yet, he compares this to the events from the first film when he did not show up at the tie-breaker race, something he heard from his grandfather.
